title: The release manifest names one compatible set, and each set is tagged and published

story.i_want_to: read in one file which versions of the server, runner, chg, its adapters and the MCP package belong together, and find that set tagged with its artifacts
story.so_that: the fleet can be rolled to a named set and every client can be judged against it

rationale: PRD R7: 'One manifest names compatible versions of every part.' Nothing does today: the server is mix.exs version 1.0.0 (mix.exs:7), the runner 0.1.0 (runner/mix.exs:7), chg 0.1.0 (chg/cli/Cargo.toml:3), the MCP package 3.19.0 (mcp-server/package.json:3), and the only cross-part version anyone checks is the runner contract's major (runner_contract.ex:4566-4570). chg is released from its own repo's v* tags (chg .github/workflows/release.yml:8-10), which US-52.11 archives. The manifest is the set record; each part's own file stays the source of its own version, and a check keeps the two equal.

acceptance_criteria.description: release/manifest.toml holds set = <positive integer> and one [components.<name>] table for each of server, runner, chg, chg_adapter_elixir, chg_adapter_typescript, chg_adapter_generic and mcp, each with version, minimum and source (the file its version is read from: mix.exs, runner/mix.exs, chg/cli/Cargo.toml, chg/adapters/elixir/mix.exs, chg/cli/Cargo.toml, chg/cli/Cargo.toml, mcp-server/package.json).

mix loopctl.release_set --check exits 1 and names each component whose manifest version differs from the version its source file declares, and exits 0 when none does; it is a step of mix precommit and of ci.yml's lint job.

mix loopctl.release_set --bump, when some source version differs, increments set, and for each such component sets version to the source's and keeps its minimum (a minimum is raised by hand, never by a bump); a component whose source did not change keeps both values; with no difference it prints 'no component changed' and leaves the file byte-identical.

Loopctl.ReleaseSet reads release/manifest.toml at compile time (@external_resource) and exposes set/0 and component/1 returning %{version: v, minimum: m}; a missing file, a missing component or a version that is neither semver nor the literal "unreported" fails compilation with the file and key named.
GET /.well-known/loopctl carries release: %{set: n, components: %{name => %{version, minimum}}} from Loopctl.ReleaseSet, and GET /.well-known/loopctl/schema.json declares the release object.
The Dockerfile copies release/manifest.toml into the build stage before mix compile, so the deployed server's discovery document reports the manifest it was built from.

.github/workflows/factory-release.yml, when the CI workflow completes successfully on a master commit (workflow_run) whose manifest set has no tag factory-<set>, tags that commit factory-<set> and publishes GitHub release factory-<set> carrying chg-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, its .sha256 and manifest.toml; a re-run finding the tag uploads the assets with --clobber and creates no second tag or release.
chg/scripts/install.sh --release factory-<n> downloads chg-<target> and its .sha256 from mkreyman/loopctl's release factory-<n> and refuses to install when the checksum does not match.

test_cases.name: --check passes on the committed tree and names a drifted component (ExUnit, Mix task)
preconditions: a temp copy of release/manifest.toml and the seven source files; the task takes its root as an option
expected_results: exit 0; exit 1 naming runner, 9.9.9 and the manifest's version

test_cases.name: --bump moves only changed components (ExUnit, Mix task)
preconditions: temp copy at set 3 with runner 0.2.0 minimum 0.1.0 and chg 0.2.0 minimum 0.2.0
expected_results: set 4; runner version 0.3.0 minimum 0.1.0; chg unchanged; second run prints 'no component changed' and the file is unchanged

test_cases.name: ReleaseSet reads the manifest and refuses a malformed one
preconditions: ReleaseSet.parse!/2 (the compile-time reader, callable on a string and a file name)
expected_results: a map with seven components; raises naming components.chg; raises naming the bad version

test_cases.name: discovery document carries the release set (ConnCase)
expected_results: release.set == ReleaseSet.set(); release.components.runner.version == ReleaseSet.component(:runner).version; the schema declares release

test_cases.name: Dockerfile and release workflow shape (ExUnit reading the files)
steps: find the COPY of release/manifest.toml and the first mix compile line
expected_results: the COPY precedes compile; the workflow triggers on workflow_run of CI, completed, branch master, proceeds only on conclusion success, runs on [self-hosted, fleet-ci], checks for an existing tag before creating one, and uploads with --clobber

test_cases.name: install.sh fetches from the loopctl release and checks the sum (chg/tests, gh stubbed on PATH)
preconditions: a gh stub that records argv and writes a binary plus a .sha256 into -D, once matching and once not
steps: install.sh --release factory-2 --dest $TMP with the matching sum
the same with a wrong sum
expected_results: gh called with -R mkreyman/loopctl factory-2; installed; then non-zero and nothing written to $TMP

technical_notes: Versions today: mix.exs:7 (1.0.0), runner/mix.exs:7 (0.1.0), chg/cli/Cargo.toml:3 (0.1.0), chg/adapters/elixir/mix.exs:10 (1.0.0), mcp-server/package.json:3 (3.19.1). The TypeScript and generic adapters have no version file and are installed from the same tree as chg (chg/scripts/install-system.sh), so their source is chg/cli/Cargo.toml. The factory pack is not a component until release 8 creates it (README names table).
The first set is 1. Its minimum for runner is "unreported" (every runner in the field predates version reporting, US-52.8); for every other component minimum equals version.

TOML parsing in Elixir needs a dependency: {:toml, "~> 0.7"} (defaults). Rust already has the toml crate (chg/cli/Cargo.toml); shell readers use python3 -I with tomllib, which chg's scripts already require.

Mix task: lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.release_set.ex beside lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.runner_contract.ex (the export task this mirrors); add 'loopctl.release_set --check' to aliases.precommit after loopctl.check_env_docs (mix.exs:294) and as a step of the lint job (ci.yml:134). Reading each source: Mix.Project-free regexes for mix.exs version:, Cargo.toml [package] version, package.json "version"; the task takes a root option so tests run on a temp copy.

Discovery: LoopctlWeb.WellKnownController @discovery_base (well_known_controller.ex:29-77), discovery_body/0 at :99, the schema at :175-238. The controller already reads mcp-server/package.json at compile time (:20-27) for mcp_server.npm_version; that field stays (mcp_version reads it) and must equal release.components.mcp.version, which the --check guarantees.
Dockerfile: COPY mcp-server/package.json at :46 is the precedent; add COPY release/manifest.toml release/manifest.toml beside it.

Release workflow replaces chg .github/workflows/release.yml (build :20-44 on fleet-ci with scripts/ci-rust-toolchain.sh, publish :46-63). Run chg's build from chg/; the release body is the manifest. Permissions contents: write on the publish job only.
install.sh: the gh release download at chg/scripts/install.sh:57-61 changes repository and tag form; its help text (:4-7) names factory-<n>.
No new table, context or route; one new field on an existing unauthenticated document, so no MCP tool (mcp_version already reads that document).
non_goals: Clients reporting their version and the server refusing an old one: US-52.8.
Installing a set on the fleet: US-52.10.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.7.7: a publish that loses GitHub midway leaves the tag; the next run finds it and uploads the assets again.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.7.4: the set lives in release/manifest.toml in git and is compiled into the server; each part's own version lives in its own source file, and AC-52.7.2 keeps the two equal.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.7.7: a re-run never creates a second tag or release; AC-52.7.3: a repeated --bump with nothing changed writes nothing.
failure_modes.slow: n/a: the workflow keeps chg's 20-minute build timeout; nothing on a request path waits on GitHub.
failure_modes.reach: n/a: the task runs in the caller's shell and the workflow on the fleet-ci pool; nothing is queued in the server.

defaults: Set numbering: an integer starting at 1, tag factory-<set> (owner may prefer a date form).
Elixir TOML dependency: toml ~> 0.7 (owner may choose another parser).

A component is compatible from its minimum up (US-52.8 enforces it). A bump does not move the minimum: a session binds its MCP server at start, so a one-release window refused every session one release behind the moment set 7 deployed (2026-11-21).
definition_of_done: After the epic merges: gh release view factory-1 -R mkreyman/loopctl lists chg-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, its .sha256 and manifest.toml.
https://loopctl.com/.well-known/loopctl, read with WebFetch after the deploy, shows release.set 1 and release.components.runner.version equal to runner/mix.exs's.
